manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed straight up and falls back. A Motion arrow changes while a gravity arrow stays the same.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: A ball moves on a fixed height scale above a launch mark. The blue Motion arrow shrinks, vanishes at the top, then points down. The dashed gravity arrow always points down with the same length.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows.

program.source: export function evaluate({inputs,time}){const u=inputs.launchSpeed,g=9.8;const T=2*u/g;const t=Math.min(Math.max(time,0),T);const ta=u/g;const v=u-g*t;const h=u*t-g*t*t/2;const top=Math.abs(t-ta)<0.004;const st=top?'Still for an instant':(v>0?'Moving up':'Moving down');const base=370,sc=60;const y=base-h*sc*1.0-14;const x=300;const vv=top?0:v;const o=[];o.push(...sdk.panel({x:20,y:40,w:600,h:370,title:'Tossed ball',state:st,id:'lane.toss'}));o.push(sdk.line('guide',120,base,560,base,{role:'neutral'}));o.push(sdk.text('guide.l',125,base+18,'Launch height',{role:'neutral'}));o.push(sdk.circle('ball.toss',x,y,28,{role:'output'}));o.push(...sdk.vector('vec.v',{x:x+50,y:y},{value:vv,direction:'up'},{scale:22,minLength:12,label:'v',role:'input'}));o.push(...sdk.vector('vec.a',{x:x+110,y:y},{value:-g,direction:'up'},{scale:6,label:'a',role:'warning'}));o.push(...sdk.callout(x-230,y-30,[st,'Gravity pulls down'],{id:'callout.toss'}));return {frame:{width:640,height:420,objects:o,readouts:[{id:'motionState',value:st},{id:'gravityState',value:'Gravity pulls down'}]},quantities:{launchSpeed:u,gravity:g,apexTime:ta,apexHeight:u*u/(2*g),velocity:v,height:h}};}
